# dsh-assistant
English | 中文
A general-purpose chat agent for DeepSeek Harness, built on a **parent agent + worker sub-agent** ar
urpose chat agent for DeepSeek Harness, built on a **parent agent + worker sub-agent** architecture.
The parent is the conversation: it plans, delegates, and approves. Workers do the work in the backgr
ound. The design explores a more autonomous agent pattern, where the parent manages worker context,
model and reasoning effort, workspace, and permission approval instead of the user operating every t
ool. Single-window self-management of the parent — its own context, model, and long-running work in
one conversation — will be added progressively in later versions.
## Requirements
**DeepSeek Harness Desktop `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`.** Only the Desktop app is supported; the web app a
nd other hosts are not.
## Install
Install `@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant` from the Plugins page of DSH Desktop, or from the command lin
stall `@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant` from the Plugins page of DSH Desktop, or from the command line:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The two sub-plugins `@starsharryzhu/complete-subagent` and `@starsharryzhu/im-robot` are installed w
sub-plugins `@starsharryzhu/complete-subagent` and `@starsharryzhu/im-robot` are installed with it.
## Architecture
Two hidden agent presets, one visible conversation:
- **Parent (router)** — the chat. It talks to you, records simple facts with narrow tools over fixed
files, and hands everything else to a worker with `delegate`. It has no general file writes, shell,
web, or official subagent tool, so it never blocks on work and can take your next message at any ti

me.
- **Workers** — background sub-agents on their own preset, with the working toolset. Each gets a
`cwd` and may modify only that sub-workspace (plus temporary directories); anything else needs `req

uest_write_access`, which the parent answers.
- **Parent as manager** — it chooses the worker's mode
l and reasoning effort from the models you enable, passes your request in your own words, never poll
s for progress, and reports only results, decisions, or failures. Worker context stays out of the co
nversation; the parent's own context is compacted automatically at a configurable ratio (50% by defa

ult).
- **Permissions** — workspace write by default, with automatic refusal outside. The parent aut
o-approves in-workspace work that matches the task; a destructive or ambiguous change gets one plain
-language question, never a modal. Each assistant can be set to read-only, workspace write, or full

access.
- **Isolation** — the parent's record tools exist only inside the two hidden presets, and ot
her plugins' global tools never enter them. This package's tools never appear in normal sessions.
## What you get
- A sidebar row that opens the last assistant's conversation; the conversation title switches betwee

n assistants or creates one (name, form of address, workspace).
- One long-running conversation per

assistant, with automatic compaction.
- Model and reasoning effort per conversation, and a multi-sel

ect list of worker models.
- Records as plain files in the workspace: schedule (`ddl.md`), lists, me

mos, logs, profile, persona, projects. Passwords, card numbers, and ID numbers are never recorded.
-

A schedule with reminders and a `/ddl` week view, a daily brief every morning, and a watchdog.
- A
heartbeat instead of automation tasks: the assistant wakes on its own every hour, and to the minute
for what is due, and it can set its own wake-ups. Whether a heartbeat with nothing due calls the mod

el is a setting.
- Quiet hours, daily and temporary. Reminders inside them move to the evening befor
e or the next morning; other WeChat messages wait for their end. The assistant changes them only whe

n you ask.
- Your own time zone in the profile, worked out from where you say you are and from your

schedule, never from the device.
- A balance reminder for the DeepSeek account, with configurable wo

rding.
- WeChat through `im-robot`: scan to bind, and the assistant introduces itself; then chat fro
m WeChat in the same conversation. The assistant decides for each reply whether it also goes to WeCh
at, so what you need to see reaches you there wherever you last wrote. Images, files, voice, and vid
eo you send are shown in the conversation and saved in the workspace's `IM/WeChat/` for 30 days (adj
ustable; 0 keeps them); the assistant copies a file out before working on it. Replies are text split

into short messages.
- Tool isolation in both directions.
## Settings
- **Plugins page** (shared by every assistant): worker models, compaction ratio, balance threshold a

nd check interval, reminder wording, persona and profile limits.
- **Each assistant's Settings tab**
: name and form of address, reminder lead time, daily brief time, heartbeat interval and idle wake,
quiet hours, watchdog timeout, WeChat switch and message length. Its **Shared settings** button open
s the Plugins page settings.
Numbers can be cleared and retyped; values are corrected when the field is left.
## Sub-plugins
Pinned as exact versions in `dependencies` and mounted only inside the two hidden presets:
- `@starsharryzhu/complete-subagent` — the delegation tools, worker model choice, and write-access r

equests.
- `@starsharryzhu/im-robot` — the WeChat bridge.
Installing either one standalone switches the bundled copy off automatically.
## Status and roadmap
Working today: the parent/worker split, per-worker model and reasoning effort, workspace confinement
with parent-approved access, automatic compaction, records, schedule and reminders, heartbeats and
quiet hours, WeChat in and out, and the watchdog.
Next: single-window self-management for the parent agent — its own context, model choice, and long-r
unning work handled in the same conversation, with fewer handoffs and less supervision.
## Known limits

- The sidebar's content search can still find assistant conversations.
- WeChat lets the assistant w
rite first only for about a day after your last WeChat message (more precisely, third-party reports
say so; Tencent documents no rule). Shortly before that — and before quiet hours if it would close i
n them or soon after — the assistant asks you on WeChat to reply once. If the day has passed anyway,
what could not be sent waits and goes out as soon as you write on WeChat again (up to a day old), a

nd the IM tab says so.
